faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about shipping, returns, payment and orders at nurvishop.
faq.title: Frequently Asked <highlight>Questions</highlight>
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about shopping with us

shippingTime.a: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business day delivery. Free shipping is offered on orders over €100.

returns.a: We offer a 30-day return policy on all items. Products must be unused and in their original packaging. Contact our support team to initiate a return.

international.a: Yes! We ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping typically takes 7-14 business days depending on the destination.

tracking.q: How can I track my order?
tracking.a: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can also track your order from your account dashboard.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely with SSL encryption.

changeOrder.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
changeOrder.a: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. After that, please contact our support team and we'll do our best to help.

giftWrap.a: Yes! Gift wrapping is available at checkout for a small additional fee. You can also include a personalized message with your gift.

support.q: How do I contact customer support?
support.a: You can reach us via our contact form, email at info@nurvishop.com, or through live chat on our website. We're available 24/7 to help.
